determinism.note: Apart from two timestamp fields, reruns with the same parameters produce byte-identical artifacts (measured: the SHA-256 of most artifacts is identical between the notebook and script paths, with differences coming only from timestamps and execution time)

pending: forecast_source: lightgbm reads M2's period.parquet directly; the 28-day cumulative quantiles of the three baselines are constructed in this module by "error addition" (S = point forecast + τ quantile of the 28-day cumulative error from earlier windows), realised coverage at τ=0.95 is 0.922–0.950, and the report must state that "the baseline cumulative quantiles are constructed by M4";

Daily quantiles: lightgbm has only four points (0.5/0.9/0.95/0.99, the only buckets in M2's daily.quantiles), while the three baselines are converted from point forecasts through the period-level scale ratio into daily quantiles with all 23 levels; the four models are therefore comparable only at the four common levels, the other 19 levels have values only for the baselines and no cross-model ranking is possible; the daily and the 28-day cumulative 23-point conventions differ and must not be mixed;

The decision map, cost and coverage exist only at sku level; accuracy metrics cover sku/store/total. The Module 03 panel's point forecasts are reconciled, but its 28-day cumulative quantiles are unreconciled and store-level quantiles are systematically high (the total level is slightly low instead, q/y 0.96–0.99), so the decision map is not extended to store and state level; those two levels serve only as point-forecast comparisons.

The simulation convention is fixed (option A chosen in the 11/16 integration): L=0, lost sales, first-period opening zero with later periods opening at the previous carry-over, and no intermediate replenishment within the 28 days; the three-party sign-off is a signature confirmation only and no further values change.

Cost per unit of demand is normalised by total demand (cost_per_unit_demand); absolute cost varies with sample size, so percentage differences across groups are readable but absolute amounts cannot be extrapolated to the full M5.
20.4% of prices cells are missing (NaN≠0): this module does not read prices, so it is not blocked, but Module 02 must confirm forward filling or a has_price flag when building price features.

In the mock branch, build_strata() produces only 4 intermittency classes and lacks no_demand: the real parquet path does not trigger it, but if a teammate falls back to mock without the parquet the decision map will miss one class.

[Done · grid extension] The theoretical optima q*=0.50 / 0.67 for Cu:Co=1:1 and 2:1 fell outside the task card's τ grid of 0.80–0.99; this round the grid was extended to 23 points (0.50 / 2/3 / 5/6 plus the twenty points 0.80–0.99), with the three new points taken from M2's native period.parquet τ and no new request to Module 02. The measured optimum moves from the grid lower bound 0.80 to 0.50 for 1:1 and to 2/3 for 2:1, both with a deviation of 0.000 from q*; the optima for 5:1 and 9:1 (0.86 / 0.92) were already inside the grid and are unchanged; the main-table cost, WAPE/MASE and bootstrap at headline τ=0.95 are digit-for-digit identical to before the extension. The deviation from the task card's 0.80–0.99 must be stated in one sentence in the report.
